name: Rotate it (3 mo/yr)
summary: Don't pay for everything at once. Keep one service, watch what you want, cancel, then switch. We count 3 months a year.
gains: You keep access to the same content
tradeoffs: You'll wait for new seasons or deals
You have to remember to cancel (set a calendar reminder)
setupSteps: Pick the one service you'll keep this month
Cancel the others now (access usually lasts until the end of the billing period)
Put a reminder in your calendar for the day before renewal
Next month, swap to another service if you want
